tested_with.status_reason: Leaf-id mapping {2,3}=programado, {5,6,7}=espontâneo covers 100% of tb_fat_atendimento_individual across the full observed history (2023-07-03 to 2026-04-30, 294114 rows). Ids 8, 9, 10, 11 of tb_dim_tipo_atendimento never occur on this instance and remain NOT_TESTED — if a future extraction encounters them, the run must raise a limitation rather than silently classifying them.

municipal_isolation_evidence.mechanism: WHERE clause parameterized on co_ibge (7-digit text), never on the installation-local surrogate co_seq_dim_municipio. tb_dim_municipio is a shared national reference table (1870 rows), not partitioned per installation; single-municipality-per-row is a property of this data, not assumed structurally.
